# Naismith AI

> @NaismithAIApp (https://x.com/NaismithAIApp) posts fast NBA injury news from X together with who to pick up for fantasy basketball. Each alert shows the injured player's fantasy points per game and up to three pickups, tagged by league size. Free.

Last updated: 2026-11-10

## Facts

- Free. No app, no account. Alerts are on X; naismithai.com has a pickups board and a player lookup.
- Posts when a player is ruled out, listed doubtful or questionable, gets a new timeline, or leaves a game. If he returns within about four hours, it replies under that post.
- Each pickup shows a projected fantasy-points-per-game gain (leaning on what the pickup actually did in games the injured player already missed; otherwise a conservative model projection), and a tag from strongest to weakest: All leagues, 12+ team, Deep league. Players averaging 32+ aren't suggested.
- Sources: the official NBA injury report, ESPN, RotoWire, CBS Sports, Bluesky, and NBA insiders and beat writers on X. The top insiders are checked about every 90 seconds.
- An AI model writes each one-line summary. Code checks it against the original report and rejects any team, day, body part or timeline the report doesn't contain. Mistakes still happen.
- A recap thread follows each night's games: top performers, breakouts and minutes to watch, with full stat lines.
- Scoring: points 1, rebounds 1.2, assists 1.5, steals 3, blocks 3, three-pointers 0.5, turnovers -1.
- Not affiliated with the NBA.

## Alert format

🚨 Star Guard (TEAM) — OUT (2-3 weeks) | 41 FPTS/g
The team says he'll be re-evaluated in two weeks.
🔥 Backup Guard (+8.4 FPTS/g) — All leagues
🎯 Bench Wing (+5.6 FPTS/g) — 12+ team
📰 ESPN Injury Report

- [Latest alerts](https://www.naismithai.com/alerts.html): everything posted on X in the last week
- [Last night's recap](https://www.naismithai.com/recap.html)
- [Today's injury report](https://www.naismithai.com/injuries): every NBA player with current injury news and the best pickups, as plain HTML
- [Injured players](https://www.naismithai.com/players): one page per player at /players/<name>, e.g. /players/stephen-curry: status, timeline, latest report, who gains
- [Player lookup](https://www.naismithai.com/app.html)
- [Privacy](https://www.naismithai.com/privacy.html)

## Connector
- [Naismith AI connector](https://www.naismithai.com/connector.html): MCP server at https://www.naismithai.com/mcp/v1 (no auth, Streamable HTTP) with live NBA injury status, timelines and pickups for AI assistants
